comparator_identity: G402 YOLOv8n person detector, same weights file, same detector family as the producer
independence: NOT INDEPENDENT. Same detector family and same weights as the producer route. This is a same-detector consistency comparator, never a teacher.

weights.selection_rule: _best_yolo_model('yolov8n') returns 'yolov8n.pt' because resources/yolov8n.engine is absent and tensorrt does not import on this pod

exercised_route.call_text: self.model(frame, classes=[0], conf=0.3, verbose=False, imgsz=_imgsz, half=self._use_half, device=self._device)
exercised_route.preprocessing: full native BGR frame straight from the decoder; the producer pipeline applies no resize before get_players_pos
exercised_route.route_file_hash_timing: read before launch to seal the arguments; digests captured after the single invocation against the read-only deploy tree

absent_at_call_site.reason: the exercised route never sets a suppression argument, so none could be sealed from it; no default was substituted and none was passed

known_runtime_notes: ultralytics 8.4.146 prints a deprecation warning for the half argument; the argument was passed exactly as the exercised route passes it and was not replaced
the comparator reads the independently decoded native PNG rather than the producer's in-process VideoCapture buffer, so decoder-level byte identity with the producer run is not established
